title: Is Cold Email From a Secondary Domain Legal? The Registration Decides
meta_description: No US, UK, EU, Canadian or Australian rule I read bans cold email from a secondary domain. Sending from two registered under a false identity is a US crime.
secondary_keywords: is it legal to use secondary domains for cold email

image.takeaway: Registering two domains under a false identity and sending over 100 commercial emails a day from them is a US crime.
image.alt: Is cold email from a secondary domain legal: under 18 U.S.C. 1037 the risk is a false registration on two or more sending domains, not the domain itself
